parameters.query:
WITH p AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j)
UPDATE users u SET needs_human = true FROM p
WHERE u.chat_id = (j->>'chat_id')::bigint AND (j->>'flag_human')::boolean
RETURNING u.chat_id
